instruction: We have an upcoming meeting with the key account a colleague flagged by email. What is the value of their most recent open offer?

provenance.construction_method: Author-constructed multi-source retrieval over a coherent named-customer dataset; natural-language prompts; sweep-all / plan-time-decidable. Labelled honestly per IT-017.
